key_highlights: ASX inched higher on energy and big miner rally, but iron ore weakness threatens BHP.AX and peers
Australian housing prices accelerating downward; property sector facing 'GFC moment' with RBA signalling no rescue
Mortgage rates rising week-over-week; Australians driven into second jobs as cost-of-living pressure intensifies
Gold and uranium exploration activity robust across ASX small-caps (Forrestania, Kaiser, Larvotto, Infini, Aureka)
BYD confirms Australia has passed EV tipping point, pressuring legacy auto and insurance names
OPEC+ to hold output unchanged; tanker tensions unlikely to suppress oil prices
Stokes family retakes control of Seven Network, reshaping ASX-listed media landscape
Qantas engine flame incident raises operational risk flags for QAN.AX

sectors.trend: Mixed: ASX miners rallied on energy strength but iron ore 'crumbling' poses existential question for BHP.AX; gold and uranium explorers showing strong discovery pipeline
sectors.implications: Large-cap iron ore exposure (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) faces margin pressure; gold/uranium small-caps (KIA.AX, FOR.AX, LRV.AX, INF.AX, AUK.AX) offer relative outperformance and exploration upside

sectors.trend: Housing price falls accelerating; RBA explicitly ruling out property rescue; mortgage rates climbing; consumer credit stress rising
sectors.implications: NAB.AX, CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face rising NPLs and weaker loan growth; REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) under pressure from falling valuations and higher financing costs; 'GFC moment' narrative risks sentiment contagion

sectors.trend: Energy stocks rallied within ASX; OPEC+ holding output steady; tanker tensions not suppressing oil; El Nino adding supply risk
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from firm oil prices; LNG exporters (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) supported; El Nino may boost gas demand

sectors.trend: Consumer under severe stress: second jobs, feeling poorer, supply crunch raising car insurance; Gap closing 350 stores globally; BYD EV tipping point shifting auto demand
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX, IAG.AX face margin pressure; BYD penetration threatens legacy auto supply chains; insurance premiums rising (IAG.AX, WBC.AX)

sectors.trend: Stokes family retakes Seven Network control; Nvidia-Hugging Face deal signals AI infrastructure consolidation; cybersecurity stocks surging
sectors.implications: Media consolidation may reduce ASX-listed media fragmentation; AI/tech themes remain global tailwind but limited ASX direct exposure

sectors.trend: Qantas engine flame incident; Spirit of Tasmania debt to 2052; 6,000 tradies to receive free qualifications under Labor scheme
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational scrutiny; SOT.AX long-term debt overhang; tradie scheme supports construction and industrial demand

key_themes: Housing correction accelerating with no RBA intervention expected
Iron ore structural weakness vs. energy/gold/uranium strength in mining
Consumer affordability crisis driving second-job participation and credit stress
EV transition tipping point in Australia pressuring legacy auto and insurance
Geopolitical fragmentation (Russia-Germany, Israel-Lebanon, NK-Russia) elevating risk premium
OPEC+ policy stability supporting energy sector

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market deterioration and credit cycle
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and bank exposure; favour dividend-paying large caps with low leverage; monitor NAB/CBA/ANZ/WBC NPL trends

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse impacting BHP/RIO/FMG
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure; rotate into gold/uranium/copper miners; monitor China stimulus signals
Maintain defensive allocation; gold as hedge; monitor AUD/USD for safe-haven flows

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Consumer demand collapse from cost-of-living pressure
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour essential-staple names (WES.AX, WTW.AX) over discretionary; watch retail sales data
Monitor QAN.AX for regulatory response and share-price reaction; single-event risk
Assess IAG.AX and WBC.AX auto insurance exposure; BYD penetration data

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and uranium explorers on discovery momentum and geopolitical hedge
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania 2Moz milestone, Kaiser inventory build, Larvotto multi-commodity strike, Infini uranium target signal strong pipeline; gold benefits from geopolitical risk premium

opportunities.recommendation: Maintain energy sector exposure on OPEC+ stability and El Nino demand support
opportunities.rationale: OPEC+ holding output, tanker tensions not suppressing oil, El Nino boosting gas demand; WDS and WLE benefit

opportunities.recommendation: Selective consumer staples positioning for defensive income
opportunities.rationale: Consumer stress supports essential-staple resilience; WES and WTW offer dividend yield and defensive characteristics

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or hedge REIT and property-linked exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Accelerating price falls, RBA non-intervention, rising mortgage rates create prolonged downside; 'GFC moment' narrative risks sentiment contagion

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim pure iron ore exposure; rotate to diversified miners
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'crumbling' threatens BHP/RIO/FMG earnings; diversify into copper, gold, energy within materials

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor bank NPL and credit-loss provisions closely
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising mortgage rates and consumer stress will pressure loan books over 2-3 quarters

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with sector rotation: energy and gold/uranium outperforming, property and iron ore lagging. Housing stress and RBA non-intervention cap upside. Geopolitical headlines add volatility. QAN.AX faces near-term operational overhang.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from housing correction, iron ore demand shift, and EV transition will pressure traditional ASX heavyweights. Gold, uranium, energy, and healthcare (CSL.AX) offer relative resilience. Consumer staples provide defensive ballast. Media consolidation may create M&A opportunities.
